name: Icon picker
description: A searchable grid of icons and emoji with a remove button, for marking a column, project, page or label with a symbol. It sits in a Popover or as the submenu panel of a Menu.

classes.ayy-icon-picker: Root: a flex column, 17rem wide at most, holding the header, the scrolling body and the empty message.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__header: Row with the search field and the remove button.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__search: The <input type="search" class="ayy-input ayy-input--sm"> that filters options by aria-label, data-keywords and data-value. ArrowDown moves into the grid, Enter picks the first match.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__remove: A ghost sm Button that clears the icon (picks "").
classes.ayy-icon-picker__body: The scrolling area (15rem tall at most) holding the sections.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__section: One <div role="group" aria-labelledby> per kind (icons, emoji). Hidden while a search leaves it no options.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__grid: The grid of options: as many sm-control-sized columns as fit.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__option: One <button type="button" aria-label aria-pressed data-value> holding an Icon SVG or an emoji character. data-keywords adds search words.
classes.ayy-icon-picker__empty:
The

shown when a search matches nothing.

default.looks: Options are transparent squares at the sm control height, icons and emoji in --ayy-color-text-soft, under muted section labels.

hover.looks: A --ayy-color-wash-hover fill and the text colour.

pressed.looks: The --ayy-color-wash-hover fill, also on touch screens.

focus.when: .ayy-icon-picker__option:focus-visible; the search field and remove button use Input's and Button's

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled and a not-allowed cursor; skipped by the arrow keys. GrayText in High Contrast.

selected.looks: A --ayy-color-primary tint at 16% with a 1px primary ring at 60%, and the text colour. A Highlight outline in High Contrast.

error.none: Picking can't fail; a search with no matches shows the empty message instead.

loading.none: Options are local; nothing to wait for.

sizes.density: Options are the sm control height (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch) and the search field is an sm Input, so data-density grows the targets.
sizes.width: 17rem at most (shrinks with its container); the grid fits as many columns as the width allows and the body scrolls past 15rem.

js: iconPickerClass({ className? }) → string; iconPickerOptionClass and the other part constants; iconPickerEmojis (a starter set of { value, label, keywords }); connectIconPicker(root, { onChange?, manageSelection? }) → { setValue, filter, refresh, destroy } wires search, the roving tab stop, arrow keys and picking. Every pick dispatches a bubbling "ayy-pick" event ({ value, kind, option }) from the root; a Menu around the picker closes on it.

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-icon-picker: search filters the options, the arrow keys, Home and End move through the grid, and clicking an option or the remove button picks it and sets aria-pressed.

attributes.value: The picked option's data-value ("" for none). Updated on pick.
attributes.name: Form name: a hidden input inside carries the value.

events.ayy-change: { value, kind } — kind is "icon", "emoji", or null when removed.

IconPicker.renders: <div class="ayy-icon-picker"> with a search Input, a remove Button and a section per kind

props.value / defaultValue: string — the picked icon value or emoji; "" for none
props.onValueChange: (value: string, change: { value, kind, option }) => void
props.icons: { value: string; label: string; icon: IconData | ReactNode; name?: IconName; keywords?: string[] }[] — the Icons section; omit for emoji only. name is the glyph's name ("star"), written as data-ayy-icon so an icon pack can replace it
props.emojis: { value: string; label: string; keywords?: string[] }[] — the Emoji section (iconPickerEmojis by default; [] hides it)
props.searchable: boolean — show the search field (default true)
props.removable: boolean — show the remove button (default true)
props.iconsLabel / emojisLabel / searchLabel /: string — the visible and accessible text

a11y: Every option is a <button> with an aria-label naming the icon or emoji (an emoji character alone is read inconsistently) and aria-pressed for the picked one, so the choice is announced, not only tinted.

Each section is a role="group" labelled by its heading. One option is the tab stop (the picked one, or the first): Tab moves search → grid → remove, and the arrow keys, Home and End move inside the grid, mirrored in RTL.

ArrowDown from the search field enters the grid and ArrowUp from the first row returns to it; Enter in the search field picks the first match. A no-match search announces the role="status" empty message.

Keys stay inside the picker except Esc, so a Menu or Popover around it still closes on Esc and returns focus. As a menu's submenu panel, give the panel role="dialog" and an aria-label, and the trigger aria-haspopup="dialog".
do: Use an icon picker to let people mark a column, project, page or label with an icon or emoji of their choice.
Offer a short, relevant icon set (the same Hugeicons the app uses) and keep the emoji section for personal flair.
Give every option a plain label and keywords, so search finds "money" under Dollar and 💰.
dont: Don't use an icon picker to choose a status, category or other fixed value with meaning — use Select, Segmented control or Swatch.
Don't list icons as one menu item each once there are more than a handful — the grid and search scale, a menu doesn't.
Don't show the picked icon without its label elsewhere when the icon carries meaning; icons are a hint, not the name.
